evaluation.feedback: The production quality is quite high, especially the crisp trap-style percussion and the deep, groovy bassline. I really like the atmospheric, dreamy mood created by the layered synth pads and the processed vocal chops—it captures a modern R&B/Lo-fi hip-hop aesthetic very well. My main takeaway is that it feels more like a high-quality backing track or a loop than a finished song; it lacks a distinct lead melody or structural progression to keep it engaging for a longer duration.
evaluation.suggested_prompt: Create an R&B track with a groovy bassline, crisp trap-style drums, and atmospheric synth pads. Add a soulful lead vocal melody with a clear verse and chorus structure to give the track more direction and variety.
